FetchWindows.Contract: a request carrying instanceStart_from=<date in W1 month> gets W1, <date in W2 month> gets W2, any other instanceStart_from gets []; no window param gets every record (the vendor default). Windows must not span more than one calendar month.

a request carrying startFrom=<date in W1 month> gets W1, <date in W2 month> gets W2, any other startFrom gets []; no window param gets every record (the vendor default). Windows must not span more than one calendar month.
DateFrom semantics are undocumented, so windows are LENIENT: W1/W2 months get their own records, any other request gets every record.
